messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete VoiceStudio as a single-file HTML site with 12 free, locally running voice tools.
- Add Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ) support throughout the tools, including voice selection, text input, speech recognition, dubbing, and keyboard assistance.

## Requirements
- Mobile-first design with rounded white cards, green accent `#309D4B`, and horizontally scrollable mobile navigation.
- Use built-in browser APIs; external scripts may come only from `cdnjs.cloudflare.com`. No sign-up or paid APIs.
- Reload voices on `voiceschanged`; provide friendly API errors and note voices depend on the browser and device.
- Voice Cloning links to `https://play.cartesia.ai`.
- Preserve existing local audio processing and clarify its limitations: Text to MP3 records microphone audio while speech synthesis plays through speakers; Speech to Text requires on-device recognition; Voice Changer and Voice Conversion are local approximations, not AI conversion.
- Add `Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ) - kn-IN` as the first option in every language dropdown; filter voices by language starting with `kn` and select a `kn-IN` voice when Kannada is chosen.
- If no Kannada voice is found, show: `Kannada voice not installed. On Android: Settings > Language > Text-to-speech > Google > Install voice data > Kannada. On Windows: Settings > Time & Language > Speech > Add voices > Kannada.`
- Set the Text to Speech and AI Voice Generator textareas to `lang="kn"` and use Noto Sans Kannada; add the four specified Kannada sample chips.
- Add Kannada speech recognition (`recognition.lang = "kn-IN"`), a Kannada typing/mic option, and a Copy button.
- Allow Kannada voice selection per AI Voiceover scene; add an English → Kannada dubbing option for pasted translated text.
- Support Kannada text and downloads in Text to MP3.
- Add a Kannada Keyboard helper with the specified common-letter buttons and an insertion target, plus the hint: `Type in English letters, then use Google Input Tools (free) to convert.`
- Keep the page UI in English and Kannada; tools remain free and use Web Speech API.

## Decisions
- Text to MP3 captures speech through the microphone because browsers do not expose speechSynthesis audio directly; warn that headphones may not be captured.
- Speech-to-Text requires on-device recognition support.
- Voice Changer and Voice Conversion use local pitch/filter approximations and clarify that real AI conversion requires a model.
- Voice Cloning is linked to Cartesia Playground and does not clone locally.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing `index.html` implements the 12-tool VoiceStudio site, navigation, inline CSS/JS, voice loading, speech synthesis, audio processing/recording, and required disclaimers.
- Wired Realistic Text to Speech speed and pitch controls; fixed AI Voice Enhancer Before/After playback.
- Extracted inline JavaScript and verified syntax with `node --check`.
- Previous request to return the complete file remains unfinished; prior response was truncated and only a partial continuation was provided.

### Active
- Implement Kannada support throughout `index.html`, including language selectors, Kannada voice detection and guidance, textareas and sample chips, recognition, voiceover, dubbing, MP3, keyboard helper, and transliteration hint.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and update `index.html` to implement the Kannada requirements across all applicable tools.
2. Run JavaScript syntax validation and verify the language/voice selection behavior.
3. Return the completed file as requested, without explanations.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file VoiceStudio implementation to update.

- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` is untracked. Other untracked files include `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh`.
- No Kannada changes have been made yet.

PURPOSE
Turn a script into a vertical (9:16, 1080x1920) or horizontal (16:9) video with voiceover, text, and visuals. Everything runs locally, with no sign-up and no paid API.


INPUTS
1. Script box: split into scenes by blank lines (max 10 scenes).
2. Language and voice per project, including Kannada (kn-IN) and English.
3. Aspect ratio selector: 9:16, 16:9, 1:1.
4. Style presets: Clean White, Dark Neon, Gradient, Minimal Black.
5. Per-scene options:
   - Upload an image or video clip as background (optional)
   - Pick an animation: Fade, Slide Up, Zoom, Typewriter
   - Scene duration: Auto (matches the voice length) or a manual slider
6. Background music: upload an mp3, with a volume slider.
7. Subtitles toggle: show the scene text as captions with a font size slider. Use Noto Sans Kannada for Kannada text.


ENGINE
- Draw each scene on a <canvas> with requestAnimationFrame (background, animated text, captions).
- Voiceover: speechSynthesis reads each scene. Use utterance events (onstart/onend) to time each scene so visuals and voice stay in sync.
- Recording: combine canvas.captureStream(30) with an audio track and record with MediaRecorder as WebM. For audio, use the Web Audio API (uploaded music) and offer a "Share tab audio" option via getDisplayMedia so the voiceover is captured. Show a clear instruction: "Choose this tab and tick Share tab audio."
- Preview button: play the video live before recording.
- Download button: save as .webm. Add a note on converting to MP4 with a free converter.
- Progress bar and a Cancel button during recording.


UI
- Matches the existing VoiceStudio style (green accent #309D4B, mobile-first).
- Scene cards list with drag-to-reorder or Up/Down buttons.
- Live canvas preview at the top.


RULES
- Only free, built-in browser APIs (Canvas, speechSynthesis, MediaRecorder, Web Audio). Scripts only from cdnjs.cloudflare.com.
- Try/catch everywhere, with friendly messages (for example, "Please use Chrome on desktop for recording").
- No data is uploaded anywhere.
- Add a note: "Browser voices may sound robotic. For a natural voice, import an audio file made with Cartesia or another TTS and use it as the voiceover track."
- Add an "Import voiceover audio" option: upload an mp3 and spread the scenes across its total length, which gives better sync and quality.


OUTPUT

- Preserve the mobile-first design, green `#309D4B` accent, rounded cards, and horizontally scrollable navigation.

- Preserve the mobile-first design, green `#309D4B` accent, rounded cards, and horizontally scrollable navigation.

## Objective
- Complete VoiceStudio as a single-file HTML site with 13 free, locally running voice tools, including Kannada support and an AI Video Creator.
- Validate and refine the implementation in `index.html`.

## Requirements
- Preserve the mobile-first design, green `#309D4B` accent, rounded cards, and horizontally scrollable navigation.
- Keep processing local and use free browser APIs; external scripts may come only from `cdnjs.cloudflare.com`.
- AI Video Creator: up to 10 blank-line-separated scenes; Kannada and English voice selection; 9:16, 16:9, and 1:1 ratios; four style presets; per-scene media, animation, and auto/manual duration; MP3 music and volume; subtitles and font-size control; canvas preview; scene reordering; WebM recording, progress, and cancellation.
- Support imported voiceover audio across scenes; explain tab-audio sharing, desktop Chrome recording, local processing, robotic browser voices, and free MP4 conversion.
- Continue supporting the existing 12 tools and prior Kannada voice, typing, recognition, and dubbing requirements.

## Decisions
- For synthesized voice recordings, use `getDisplayMedia` tab audio; users must choose this tab and enable “Share tab audio.”
- Imported voiceover and music use Web Audio; combine canvas and audio tracks for WebM recording.
- Reuse persistent Web Audio media-element sources and route monitoring/recording separately to support repeated recordings and avoid duplicating music in tab audio.
- Music volume is applied to the audio element; Web Audio gain nodes separately control monitoring and recording.
- For imported voiceover timing, keep manual scene durations fixed and distribute remaining audio time across auto scenes; if all scenes are manual, add remaining audio time to the last scene.
- Kannada voice availability depends on installed browser/device voices; Voice Conversion and Voice Changer are local approximations, and dubbing does not provide automatic translation or video export.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added AI Video Creator and all 13 tools to `index.html`.
- Implemented scene rendering, media controls, canvas preview, WebM recording logic, and manual-duration-aware voiceover timing.
- Fixed background-music volume control and clarified voiceover timing in the UI.
- Passed JavaScript syntax checking and headless Chromium smoke testing; verified scene creation, music volume updates, and mixed/all-manual voiceover timing.

### Active
- Validate actual WebM recording, including repeated recordings, music playback, and cancellation, in desktop Chrome.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test tab-audio sharing and WebM recording in desktop Chrome, including cancellation and repeated recordings.
2. Fix any issues found and report the validation results.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file VoiceStudio implementation; contains all 13 tools and inline JavaScript.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` is untracked. Other untracked files include `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh`.
- Real recording was not tested in the headless environment; tab-audio sharing and WebM capture still need desktop Chrome verification.

## Objective
- Complete VoiceStudio as a single-file HTML site with 15 free, locally running tools, including Kannada support and Image to Video and Text to Video.
- Return the complete updated HTML file without explanations.

- Preserve the mobile-first design, green `#309D4B` accent, rounded cards, and horizontally scrollable navigation.

- Image to Video: support 1–20 reorderable images, per-image duration, motion, transition, captions, aspect ratio, fit mode, audio, filters, canvas preview, progress, cancellation, and WebM download.
- Text to Video: support up to 12 scenes, sentence auto-splitting, six style presets, per-scene animation/background/emoji, Kannada-capable voice and language selection, subtitles, audio, preview, progress, cancellation, and WebM download.
- Include: “This creates slideshow-style and animated-text videos. It does not generate AI footage.”
- Continue supporting the existing tools and Kannada voice, typing, recognition, and dubbing requirements.
- Explain local processing, desktop Chrome recording, tab-audio sharing, and free MP4 conversion; use friendly error messages.

- For synthesized voice recordings, use `getDisplayMedia`; users must choose this tab and enable “Share tab audio.”
- Imported voiceover and music use Web Audio; combine canvas and audio tracks for WebM recording.

- For existing AI Video Creator voiceover timing, keep manual scene durations fixed and distribute remaining audio time across auto scenes; if all scenes are manual, add remaining audio time to the last scene.

- Top bar with a sidebar icon and the title "Instant Clone"

- Segmented tabs: "Record" and "Upload"
- Record tab:
  - Title "Record a voice clip", then a big green Record button
  - On tap: request the mic and record with MediaRecorder
  - Show a live timer, a waveform bar, and Stop and Re-record buttons, with a 60-second auto-stop
  - After recording: an audio player preview and a trim control (start and end sliders)
- Upload tab:
  - A drag-and-drop or tap area for mp3, wav, m4a, or webm
  - Audio preview, duration display, and the same trim control
- Show a warning if the clip is under 10 seconds. Show "Great!" when it is 10–60 seconds.


"FOR BEST RESULTS" CARD (green check icons)
- Avoid long silences and pauses
- Pacing and volume you'd like the cloned voice to match
- Trim your clip before submission to remove silence, clicks, pops, etc.
- Provide up to 60 seconds of audio to better preserve less widely spoken accents


"NEED SOMETHING TO READ?" CARD
- Show a sample script in a quoted block, with a language switch (English, Kannada, Hindi):
  - English: "I'm recording audio to clone my voice. Afterwards, I'll be able to produce speech that sounds just like me. I can't wait to hear what it sounds like!"
  - Kannada and Hindi: write a similar natural paragraph.
- Use the Noto Sans Kannada font for Kannada.


EXPERIMENTAL CONTROLS (collapsible with a chevron)
- Toggles: Noise reduction (Web Audio filter), Normalize volume, Auto-trim silence


FORM FIELDS
- name (required, red asterisk)
- description (optional)
- language (required): dropdown with English, Kannada, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Spanish, French, and more

- Validate that the clip, name, language, and consent are all filled.


CLONE ENGINE (two modes, chosen with a switch)
1. API mode: the user pastes their own Cartesia API key (kept in memory only, never saved). Send multipart/form-data to https://api.cartesia.ai/voices/clone with fields clip, name, description, language. Headers: X-API-Key and a Cartesia-Version field the user can edit. Show the response (voice ID) in a result card with a Copy button. Show a friendly error for CORS or network failures, and suggest running a tiny proxy.
2. Offline demo mode: no AI cloning. Save the clip locally, and let the user preview it with pitch and speed adjustments and download it.

- "Test your voice" box: type text (up to 500 chars), pick the cloned voice, and press Play. In API mode, call the Cartesia TTS bytes endpoint and play the MP3 result.
- A "My voices" list kept in memory for the session.


RULES
- Only built-in browser APIs (MediaRecorder, Web Audio, fetch). Scripts only from cdnjs.cloudflare.com.
- Try/catch everywhere with friendly messages (for example, "Mic permission denied" or "Use Chrome").
- No audio is uploaded anywhere except to the user's chosen API in API mode.
- Add a privacy note: "Only clone voices you own or have permission to use."


OUTPUT

Build a single-file HTML "Voice Clone Studio" page. Mobile-first, dark theme (#141414 background, #1c1c1c cards, light-green buttons #A8D5A2 with dark text, rounded corners). It has 3 steps with a progress bar at the top: 1. Upload, 2. Clone, 3. Create.

SETTINGS (top card)
- Input for the user's own Cartesia API key (password type, kept in memory only, never saved or logged)
- Link: "Get a free API key" to https://play.cartesia.ai/sign-up
- Editable field for the Cartesia-Version header
- Language dropdown (English, Kannada, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Spanish, French). Note: "The language of the voice sample must match the language you generate."


STEP 1: UPLOAD VOICE
- Tabs: Upload and Record
- Upload: tap or drag-and-drop for mp3, wav, m4a, or webm. Record: MediaRecorder with a timer and a 60-second auto-stop.
- Audio preview player, duration display, and trim sliders (start and end)
- Checklist card: avoid long silences, no background noise or music, one speaker only, 10–60 seconds, trim clicks and pops
- Show a warning under 10 seconds and "Great!" between 10 and 60 seconds
- Optional toggles: noise reduction (Web Audio filter), normalize volume, auto-trim silence


STEP 2: CLONE
- Fields: voice name (required), description (optional), language (required)
- Required consent checkbox: "This is my own voice, or I have the speaker's permission."
- "Clone" button: validate everything, then send multipart/form-data to https://api.cartesia.ai/voices/clone with fields clip, name, description, language. Headers: X-API-Key and Cartesia-Version.
- Show a loading state, then a result card with the voice ID and a Copy button
- Friendly error messages (invalid key, clip too short, CORS or network failure). On a CORS error, show a short note on using a tiny proxy.


STEP 3: CREATE AI VOICE
- Voice dropdown: all cloned voices from this session, plus a "Paste voice ID" option
- Textarea (500 chars, live counter) with sample chips, and Kannada support (Noto Sans Kannada font, lang="kn")
- Controls: speed, volume, and emotion (Neutral, Happy, Calm, Excited)
- "Generate" button: POST to the Cartesia text-to-speech bytes endpoint with the voice ID, the text, and mp3 output. Play the result in an audio player.
- Buttons: Download MP3, Regenerate, and "Save to My Voices" (session memory)
- A history list of generated clips, each with Play and Download


FALLBACK (no API key)
- A free "Demo mode" switch: skip cloning, let the user play the uploaded sample with pitch and speed presets (Deep, Bright, Slow, Fast) using the Web Audio API, and read typed text with the browser speechSynthesis voices. Label it clearly: "Demo only. This is not a real clone."


RULES
- Only built-in browser APIs (MediaRecorder, Web Audio, fetch, speechSynthesis). Scripts only from cdnjs.cloudflare.com.
- Try/catch everywhere, with friendly messages ("Mic permission denied", "Use Chrome").
- No audio goes anywhere except the user's own API calls.
- Footer note: "Only clone voices you own or have permission to use. Do not use cloned voices to impersonate or deceive anyone."


OUTPUT
Return the complete working code in one HTML file with inline CSS and JS. No explanations.

## Objective
- Deliver a standalone, single-file Instant Clone voice-cloning page without replacing the existing VoiceStudio page.

## Requirements
- Mobile-first dark theme with `#141414` background, `#1c1c1c` cards, `#A8D5A2` buttons, rounded corners, monospace labels, and Noto Sans Kannada.
- Support recording with a live timer and waveform, 60-second auto-stop, preview and trimming, and MP3/WAV/M4A/WebM upload.
- Include clip-length guidance, sample scripts in English/Kannada/Hindi, and collapsible local audio-processing controls.
- Require voice name, language, and consent; include a language-match helper and privacy note.
- Cartesia API mode must keep the key in memory, send multipart clip data to `https://api.cartesia.ai/voices/clone`, allow editing `Cartesia-Version`, and provide voice ID, copy, errors, and proxy guidance.
- Offline demo must not upload or clone; provide local preview with pitch/speed controls and clip download.
- After cloning, provide a 500-character TTS test, voice picker, Play control, and session-only “My voices”.
- Keep the implementation standalone with inline CSS/JavaScript; preserve `index.html`.
